The '''Z50 grenade launcher''' was a model of medium-range [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]] produced by [[Malaxan Firepower Incorporated/Legends|Malaxan Firepower Incorporated]] and sold for 1250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], although without ammunition. The weapon fired [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] equal in power to hand grenades but smaller in size, although it was capable of launching hand grenades. The ammunition grenades could not be thrown by hand, and cost the same as normal hand grenades, although some [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] sold cases of six at half price during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Z50 had less firing options then a [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] and was less powerful, but was lighter to carry.<ref name="DC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Z50 was first shown in ''[[Dangerous Covenants]]'' a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game produced by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="DC" /> The weapon appears to be based on the design of the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Milkor_MGL Milkor MGL], a real-life grenade launcher.
